description: Choose a city and plan daily routes. Add another city when your trip takes you farther. Keep track of packing, expenses, check-ins and photos. Photos stay on your device. Optional AI title suggestions use event times and coordinates.
release_notes: Find sights near a hotel or hotels near a sight or transport stop directly from the itinerary. If a hotel stay continues past your scheduled route, Add stop and Add hotel open in its city when the day's stays identify one destination.
